parameters.query:
SELECT
    r.id AS reel_id,
    r.shortcode,
    r.object_key,
    r.sha256,
    r.file_size_bytes,
    $2::TEXT AS pipeline_version,
    $3::TEXT AS contract_version,
    $4::TEXT AS language_hint,
    $5::UUID AS retry_of_attempt_id,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.reel_enrichments AS enrichment
        WHERE enrichment.reel_id = r.id
          AND enrichment.source_object_key = r.object_key
          AND enrichment.source_sha256 = r.sha256
          AND enrichment.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
    ) AS has_applicable_result
FROM app.reels AS r
WHERE r.id = $1::BIGINT
  AND r.status = 'downloaded'
  AND r.object_key IS NOT NULL
  AND r.object_key <> ''
  AND r.sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND r.file_size_bytes > 0
  AND (
      $5::UUID IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS previous_attempt
          WHERE previous_attempt.attempt_id = $5::UUID
            AND previous_attempt.reel_id = r.id
            AND previous_attempt.source_object_key = r.object_key
            AND previous_attempt.expected_sha256 = r.sha256
            AND previous_attempt.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
            AND previous_attempt.status = 'failed'
            AND previous_attempt.retryable = TRUE
      )
  );

INSERT INTO app.reel_enrichment_attempts (
    attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
    expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint,
    retry_of_attempt_id, status, started_at
)
VALUES (
    $1::UUID, $2::BIGINT, $3, $4, $5::BIGINT, $6, $7, $8,
    $9::UUID, 'processing', NOW()
)
RETURNING
    attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
    expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint,
    $10::TEXT AS shortcode;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contract_version: $json.contract_version, attempt_id: $json.attempt_id, reel_id: Number($json.reel_id), shortcode: $json.shortcode, object_key: $json.source_object_key, expected_sha256: $json.expected_sha256, expected_size_bytes: Number($json.expected_size_bytes), pipeline_version: $json.pipeline_version, language_hint: $json.language_hint } }}

parameters.jsCode:
const attempt = $('DB — Criar tentativa processing').item.json;
const nonEmpty = (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '';
const positive = (value) => Number.isFinite(Number(value)) && Number(value) > 0;
const nonNegative = (value) => Number.isFinite(Number(value)) && Number(value) >= 0;
const audio = $json.media?.audio;
const transcriptionInput = $json.transcription_input;
const outcome = $json.transcription?.outcome;
const hasValidAudio = audio !== null
  && nonEmpty(audio?.codec)
  && positive(audio?.sample_rate_hz)
  && positive(audio?.channels)
  && (audio?.duration_seconds === null || audio?.duration_seconds === undefined || nonNegative(audio.duration_seconds));
const hasValidTranscriptionInput = transcriptionInput !== null
  && nonEmpty(transcriptionInput?.format)
  && positive(transcriptionInput?.sample_rate_hz)
  && positive(transcriptionInput?.channels)
  && nonNegative(transcriptionInput?.duration_seconds);
const validOutcome = (outcome === 'no_audio'
  && audio === null
  && transcriptionInput === null
  && $json.transcription.transcript_text === null
  && $json.transcription.transcript_language === null)
  || (outcome === 'transcribed'
  && hasValidAudio
  && hasValidTranscriptionInput
  && nonEmpty($json.transcription.transcript_text))
  || (outcome === 'empty_transcript'
  && hasValidAudio
  && hasValidTranscriptionInput
  && $json.transcription.transcript_text === '');
const valid = $json.attempt_id === attempt.attempt_id
  && Number($json.reel_id) === Number(attempt.reel_id)
  && $json.shortcode === attempt.shortcode
  && $json.pipeline_version === attempt.pipeline_version
  && $json.contract_version === attempt.contract_version
  && $json.source?.object_key === attempt.source_object_key
  && $json.source?.sha256 === attempt.expected_sha256
  && Number($json.source?.size_bytes) === Number(attempt.expected_size_bytes)
  && positive($json.source?.size_bytes)
  && nonEmpty($json.processor_version)
  && nonEmpty($json.media?.container_format)
  && nonNegative($json.media?.duration_seconds)
  && nonEmpty($json.media?.video?.codec)
  && positive($json.media?.video?.width)
  && positive($json.media?.video?.height)
  && nonEmpty($json.processing?.completed_at)
  && validOutcome;

if (!valid) {
  return {
    attempt_id: attempt.attempt_id,
    error_code: 'INVALID_ENRICHER_RESPONSE',
    error_stage: 'orchestration',
    error_message: 'Enricher response did not match the active attempt contract',
    retryable: false,
    valid_response: false,
  };
}

return { ...$json, valid_response: true };

parameters.query:
WITH completed_attempt AS (
    UPDATE app.reel_enrichment_attempts
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        finished_at = NOW(),
        enricher_version = $2,
        stt_provider = $3,
        stt_model = $4,
        provider_request_id = $5
    WHERE attempt_id = $1::UUID
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING attempt_id
)
INSERT INTO app.reel_enrichments (
    reel_id, source_attempt_id, source_object_key, source_sha256,
    source_size_bytes, pipeline_version, completed_at,
    container_format, media_duration_seconds, video_codec, video_width, video_height,
    audio_present, audio_codec, audio_sample_rate_hz, audio_channels, audio_duration_seconds,
    transcription_audio_format, transcription_audio_sample_rate_hz,
    transcription_audio_channels, transcription_audio_duration_seconds,
    outcome, transcript_text, transcript_language
)
SELECT
    $6::BIGINT, completed_attempt.attempt_id, $7, $8,
    $9::BIGINT, $10, $11::TIMESTAMPTZ,
    $12, $13::NUMERIC, $14, $15::INTEGER, $16::INTEGER,
    $17::BOOLEAN, $18, $19::INTEGER, $20::INTEGER, $21::NUMERIC,
    $22, $23::INTEGER, $24::INTEGER, $25::NUMERIC,
    $26, $27, $28
FROM completed_attempt
RETURNING id, source_attempt_id, outcome;
